text:
Your bank isn't going to call you to say you're overpaying.

We had a client sitting on 6.84% who had no idea they could do better. We refinanced them down to 5.99%. That's over $300 a month back in their pocket, not the bank's.

Same client. Same lender history. Just nobody had checked.

That's the thing with the banks. They're not going to chase you down with a better deal. They don't work for you. We do. That's why we go out to our panel of 40+ lenders instead of sitting back and hoping one bank looks after you, because odds are it won't.

If you haven't had your rate checked in a while, there's a decent chance you're the one funding someone else's good year.

CTA: Book a Discovery Session and we'll check your rate.
